values.short: Give the user message almost no context material: state the request directly, with only the minimum information needed to make it intelligible.
values.medium: Give the user message a small amount of context material: one or two sentences of background, setup or constraints before the request itself.
values.long_context: Give the user message a large amount of context material to work from — a long passage, log, document excerpt or conversation history — and require the answer to be grounded in that material, not in a longer restatement of the question.
